candidate_scope.purpose: Bounded declaration/qualification evidence only; does not assert a v15.7 canonical DesignEpoch or admission.

contracts.authority_semantics: Produces bounded release-verification evidence only. It cannot authorize canonical promotion, reset a compromised trust root, mint signing authority, or replace the existing release/admission owner.
contracts.input_semantics: Caller supplies an authenticated pinned TUF bootstrap root and identity, persistent repository cache, metadata fetcher, immutable artifact bytes/name, hash-bound signed in-toto layout and verification keys, snapshotted link directory, expected source materials, and exact expected build command.
contracts.output_semantics: Returns one GardenReleaseVerificationReceipt/v1 whose overall state is VERIFIED only when TUF, in-toto, and identical artifact identity checks are all VALID; binds bootstrap-root hash plus active trusted-root version/hash read from the caller-owned persistent cache after refresh; promotion_authorized is always false.
contracts.precondition_semantics: Required upstream libraries are installed; artifact_bytes and trusted_root are bytes; paths, fetcher, keys, expected materials and command have the documented upstream-compatible and JSON-serializable shapes; trusted-root bytes match their declared SHA-256; the caller preserves the repository-specific persistent metadata cache; layout policy bytes match their declared SHA-256.
contracts.postcondition_semantics: Every check has a visible typed status; observed trust/policy/source/artifact identities and tool versions are recorded; no input artifact or canonical state is mutated.
contracts.error_semantics: Within the declared callable preconditions, TUF or in-toto verification failures—including missing policy/link files, expired or insufficiently signed metadata, rollback, unauthorized builder, mismatched materials/commands and substituted content—produce BLOCKED with INVALID or INCOMPLETE per-check evidence. Violations of the Python/API shape preconditions or absent upstream packages may raise before a receipt exists; they cannot yield VERIFIED and must be handled by the caller as invocation failure.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Timeout becomes INCOMPLETE. Missing/unresolvable trust, metadata, policy, link, material, command, or artifact identity never becomes VALID. Total root compromise is not automatically recoverable.
contracts.effect_semantics: Reads supplied artifact/policy inputs, snapshots layout and links into a temporary verification directory, and lets upstream TUF update the caller-owned persistent metadata cache. It performs no release publication, deployment, canonical pointer change, network action beyond the supplied fetcher, or promotion.
contracts.dependency_semantics: Runtime behavior is bound to requirements/assurance.txt and the exact installed tuf, in-toto, and securesystemslib versions recorded by the qualification receipt and reuse manifest.

resource_bounds.termination: Bounded by supplied fetcher behavior, upstream verification termination, finite metadata/layout/link inputs, and caller execution limits; fetch timeout is represented as INCOMPLETE.
resource_bounds.disk: Persistent TUF cache plus one temporary copy of the signed layout and discovered link files.
resource_bounds.memory: Artifact bytes, trust metadata, policy keys, and one in-memory snapshot of layout/link bytes; caller must impose environment-appropriate size limits before production use.
resource_bounds.network: Only through the caller-supplied TUF FetcherInterface; deterministic qualification uses an in-memory fetcher.
resource_bounds.unresolved: Production input-size, wall-clock, memory, fetch, and cache quotas are not established by this bounded qualification.
